comment: Dr. Downey was a great professor. Her feedback helped me improve in my writing and she was always a great help

Downey's a good lab instructor. She makes herself available for questions. Often, she'll give you the correct answer or a very strong hint. However, the grading criteria for some things weren't very clear, which did drag my organic chemistry grade down.

Dr. Downey was my favorite lab professor I've had. She is relaxed and understands that we're more than students, we're also people. Her explanations of new material for analyzing NMR were understandable and easy to digest. I would take her again in a heartbeat!! Highly recommend. Orgo 2 lab was so fun with her.

I had Dr. Downey for Orgo II lab. She was fantastic in helping students out during lab and was available outside of lab to receive help on the lab notebook and lab reports. I was dreading taking a night lab, but I actually ended up really liking it! I'd highly recommend taking Dr. Downey!
